extensions/answer.ts.remark: diverged: local adds markdown rendering for question text and context (Markdown component + getMarkdownTheme). Upstream renders questions as plain wrapped text. Local model selection follows upstream's resolve-then-complete pattern but prefers openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna, then the extension-defined exe-dev-openai/gpt-5.6-luna@llm model, then the current model. The exe.dev registered model alias is normalized to its gateway-native request ID because ModelRegistry.complete() bypasses agent request hooks. Also: keybinding system (keyHint vs hardcoded), visual (editor theme, confirmation dialog style)
